notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
English text translation completion 70%

10 new urban features have been added.

Opening up, construction of war facilities and school palaces.

The demand for exchange characters has been adjusted.

New capture function of female military general: capture the female military general by occupying the city where the female military general is located.

Only the person who performs the search can get the location of the female military general.

Added a new person to do the best - Yongji.

New language, traditional Chinese.
